{{Quote|Anything a soldier needs, and some things he doesn't|Tracer speaks to a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tracer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the wars Tracer was stationed on [[Carrick Station]] where he sold equipment. Among the items he sold were [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], such as the [[D-25 Turbo Disruptor]], [[F-9 Laser Enforcer]], and the [[F-9 Laser Enforcer]], and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TOR" />
